description: This script performs a cleanup of specific cache directories used by a Next.js project. It removes cache folders such as `.next` and `node_modules/.cache` to prevent stale paths from causing issues like CSS/JS 404 errors during development. The script handles environment-specific constraints by avoiding destructive shell commands and instead uses Node.js filesystem APIs for safe removal.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message to standard output with a newline appended.

methods.name: rmDirIfExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists; if so, deletes it recursively and forcefully, and logs the action.
